name: Daisy
source:
Erotica and slapstick comedy collide in an all-new Touching Mode game!
This time around the touch companion is... an alien!? 

Investigate this unconfirmed life form! Her name is Daisy. Why has she come? And why does this game have alpacas in it!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061253.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
情色与闹剧在全新的触摸模式游戏中碰撞！
这次的触摸伙伴是……外星人！？

调查这种未经证实的生命形式！她的名字叫黛西。她为什么来了？为什么这个游戏里有羊驼！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061253.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
